text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen. The crowd cheers with even more enthusiasm than what was exhibited during the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined to show her resolve, Mejiro McQueen heads to her latest of many matches with Mejiro Ryan.
